tools.name: method
tools.description: How the SEA Cold Chain register is built: what is counted, sources, provenance per value, capacity, tiers, the 90-day re-check, and what the public totals do and do not show.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "method" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
